adjudication.rationale: The diff adds admin routes for GET and PUT /admin/customize/embedding (config/routes.rb) and an Admin::EmbeddingController#update that only re-renders the current embedding object without persisting any changes (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb). On the client, admin-embedding.js.es6 defines a saveChanges action calling embedding.update({}), but the new embedding.hbs template never invokes saveChanges (it only lists hosts and has an Add Host button). This makes the PUT endpoint and saveChanges action effectively dead/misleading as introduced by the diff, but it does not introduce a clear runtime defect since embedding changes are actually done via embeddable_hosts CRUD.
